Package neqsim.process.safety.selfheating

Class PorousMediaSelfHeatingResult

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.safety.selfheating.PorousMediaSelfHeatingResult
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class PorousMediaSelfHeatingResult extends Object implements Serializable
Result of a PorousMediaSelfHeatingAnalyzer Frank-Kamenetskii criticality screening.

Reports the dimensionless criticality parameter against its shape-dependent critical value, together with the two engineering answers that follow from it: the critical boundary temperature for the given body size, and the critical size for the given boundary temperature. The second is often the more useful, because insulation thickness is usually easier to change than process temperature.

1.0

  • Constructor Details

    • PorousMediaSelfHeatingResult

      public PorousMediaSelfHeatingResult(SelfHeatingGeometry geometry, double characteristicDimensionM, double effectiveConductivityWPerMK, double activationEnergyJPerMol, double volumetricPreFactorWPerM3, double boundaryTemperatureK, double delta, double deltaCrit, double deltaRatio, double criticalTemperatureK, double criticalDimensionM, double temperatureMarginK, double dimensionMarginM, double fkTemperatureScaleK, SelfHeatingVerdict verdict, List<String> warnings)
      Construct a self-heating criticality result.
      Parameters:
      geometry - the body shape used
      characteristicDimensionM - characteristic half-dimension in m
      effectiveConductivityWPerMK - effective thermal conductivity in W/(m K)
      activationEnergyJPerMol - apparent activation energy in J/mol
      volumetricPreFactorWPerM3 - volumetric heat-release pre-exponential factor in W/m3
      boundaryTemperatureK - boundary temperature in K
      delta - the Frank-Kamenetskii criticality parameter, dimensionless
      deltaCrit - the critical value of delta for the shape, dimensionless
      deltaRatio - ratio delta / deltaCrit, dimensionless
      criticalTemperatureK - critical boundary temperature for the given size in K, NaN if not bracketed
      criticalDimensionM - critical half-dimension at the given boundary temperature in m
      temperatureMarginK - critical temperature minus boundary temperature in K, positive when safe
      dimensionMarginM - critical dimension minus actual dimension in m, positive when safe
      fkTemperatureScaleK - the Frank-Kamenetskii temperature scale R*Ta^2/E in K
      verdict - the screening verdict
      warnings - list of warnings and configuration notes; may be null
